correctness.rationale: Built compatibility graph of all 32 length-five binary words by pairwise disjoint deletion shadows; it has 305 edges. Independently enumerated maximal cliques by Bron–Kerbosch and obtained size histogram 3:12,4:300,5:288,6:6, with exactly source six listed size-six codebooks, proving maximum<=6 without relying on size-seven sample. Directly recomputed three complement/reversal orbits and received-shadow coverage 16 for precisely the two matching VT syndromes 0,3 and 14 for other four. Original verifier also exhausts all C(32,6)=906192 and C(32,7)=3365856 subsets and compares LCS adjacency.
